title: Operator decision briefing
summary: Map across the eight decision-pending dossiers: one section per decision, ordered by leverage using cost of delay (95 days requeue rework in 30 days, up to 21.8 weekly quota points per wave recurrence, 1.2-day median post-processing wait). Each section carries recommendation, evidence, cost of delay, approval consequences, open questions, and a confidence tag; a closing table gives the one-line ask and recommended answer per key.
